parts.text: I know that our drones are of several models from different manufacturers that differ in how much they can carry, how far they can fly on a full battery, which sensors they carry, and which charging connector they use. We run deliveries that carry a load from one site to another, and inspections that take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order. Beyond that, I don't know what I need to know about a load or a drone's capability to carry it.
